theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: How a Bank Scandal Is Taking Down Trump’s Ally in Paraguay
top_news.summary: Officials at the Inter-American Development Bank’s investment arm suspected something was off almost as soon as they walked through the doors of Paraguay’s Ueno Bank SA.

top_news.title: The Corner Store Brings Its New York Experience to the Las Vegas Strip
top_news.summary: Catch Hospitality Group is opening a Las Vegas location of The Corner Store at the Cosmopolitan. Co-Founder and Partner Eugene Remm says the 150-seat restaurant will preserve the intimacy and authentic SoHo experience of its 75-seat New York original, rather than offer a Vegas-specific or watered-down version. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: FIGS Beats Earnings as Demand Outstrips Supply, CEO Trina Spear Says
top_news.summary: FIGS reported third-quarter top- and bottom-line results above expectations, with revenue of $190.7 million versus an estimate of $182.8 million. The company logged a fourth consecutive quarter of at least 25% revenue growth; non-scrubwear revenue rose 35%, and international revenue also increased. CEO and co-founder Trina Spear said health care professionals are expanding their FIGS purchases beyond scrubs to items such as underscrubs, compression socks and outerwear, for work and off-duty wear

top_news.title: AI-Generated Movie Heading Theaters
top_news.summary: Artificial intelligence is moving from experimental videos to the big screen. Fable Studio CEO Edward Saatchi says a team of just 30 people spent nine months creating Gods Don’t Give Gifts, an AI-generated animated feature that still relies on human directors, writers, voice actors and artists. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss how AI changes the filmmaking process and what it means for Hollywood's traditional production model. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Providing Capital to Tech Companies: Masters In Business with Ann Berry
top_news.summary: Barry speaks with Ann Berry, founder and managing partner of Threadneedle. They discuss her path from Goldman Sachs M&A and private equity to running a hospitality services company through the pandemic. They also discuss Ann's early-stage bets on AI and deepfake detection, and surveying the expanding IPO landscape. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Canadian Dollar Notches Worst Week Since September on Weak Jobs
top_news.summary: The Canadian dollar posted its biggest weekly loss since late September after weaker-than-expected domestic employment data reinforced concerns about the outlook for the country’s economy.

top_news.title: Ann Berry on the Importance of Learning AI
top_news.summary: Barry speaks with Ann Berry, founder and managing partner of Threadneedle. They discuss her path from Goldman Sachs M&A and private equity to running a hospitality services company through the pandemic. They also discuss Ann's early-stage bets on AI and deepfake detection, and surveying the expanding IPO landscape. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Airbnb Surges 12% as Growth Accelerates and Outlook Rises | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Kailey Leinz, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Hedge Funds Fled Bullish Oil Bets Ahead of Election Day Drop
top_news.summary: Hedge funds cut bullish crude bets by the most since June as the US and Iran struck rare de-escalatory notes, positioning them to profit from the selloff after the Democratic sweep of Congress.

top_news.title: Gold Extends Drop on Stronger-Than-Expected US Employment Data
top_news.summary: Gold fell after a hot US nonfarm payrolls print added fuel to speculations that the Federal Reserve will seek to raise interest rates to contain inflation.
